scope: Step18 group A: owned loopback Nextcloud fixture protocol probe (host side, before native code). ADR0027.

checks.loginFlowV2: POST /index.php/login/v2 -> login + poll on the same origin; poll 404 before grant; 200 once with server/loginName/appPassword (72 chars); later poll 404 (single use)
checks.loginOriginGuard: browser login POST without same-origin Origin header is refused (loginErrors invalidOrigin); fixture driver sends it
checks.revoke: DELETE /ocs/v2.php/core/apppassword with OCS-APIREQUEST:true -> 200; same app password then PROPFIND -> 401
checks.forbiddenNames: capabilities list forbidden extensions .part/.filepart and basename .htaccess; PUT to x.part -> 412, MOVE -> 500. Kloda temporary names .kloda-upload-* are not affected; source files with these names must surface a visible per-file error.

limits: Host-side protocol probe only. No native code, no device, no real provider account, not a working-provider claim.
